Subject: Private deployment architecture review request — Starlit Health

Hi Stephanie,

We'd like to kick off an architecture review for a private deployment of Redwood for Starlit Health. High level constraints: we must run in our VPC with cross-account peering, support HSM-backed key management (Azure Key Vault / HSM acceptable), and the instance needs to be air-gapped for a subset of environments (no outbound internet for inference nodes). We also need a plan for offline model updates and documented audit/logging for SOC2.

Can your team do a technical deep-dive next week? Ideal attendees from our side: myself (platform lead), Tom Reynolds (infrastructure), and our legal representative for compliance questions.

I've attached our initial requirements spreadsheet (starlit_requirements_v1.xlsx).

Thanks,
Anika Gupta
Platform Lead, Starlit Health
